title: 휴대폰 수리 맡기기: 어디가, 언제 고장 나요?
objective: Use -(으)ㄹ 때 to explain when your phone has a problem.
summary: Explain what is wrong with your phone and leave it for repair.
setting: A customer brings a broken phone to the counter of a phone service center.

task.title: Describe the phone problem
task.line: Use the dialogue and word list to choose, complete, or write the Korean you need at the repair counter.

words.meaning: to break down, to stop working
words.exampleMeaning: The air conditioner broke down, so it's really hot.

words.meaning: to leave (something) with someone, e.g. for repair
words.exampleMeaning: I left my laptop at the repair shop.

words.meaning: when (doing something); after a vowel or ㄹ use -ㄹ 때 (e.g. 살다 → 살 때), after other consonants use -을 때
words.exampleMeaning: My tooth hurts when I eat.

words.meaning: to turn off by itself, to go off

words.exampleMeaning: I dropped my wallet on the stairs.

words.meaning: receipt or claim slip you get when you leave something
words.exampleMeaning: You must not lose the claim slip.

dialogue.meaning: Welcome. How can I help you?

dialogue.korean: 휴대폰이 고장 난 것 같아요. 충전할 때 화면이 자꾸 꺼져요.
dialogue.meaning: I think my phone is broken. The screen keeps turning off when I charge it.
Did you drop the phone by any chance?

dialogue.korean: 네, 지난주에 한 번 떨어뜨렸어요. 그리고 통화할 때 소리도 잘 안 들려요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I dropped it once last week. Also, I can't hear well when I'm on a call.
How much will the repair cost?

dialogue.korean: 점검해 보고 정확한 금액을 문자로 알려 드릴게요. 오늘 맡기시면 내일 오후에 찾으실 수 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: We'll check it and text you the exact amount. If you leave it today, you can pick it up tomorrow afternoon.

dialogue.korean: 여기 접수증이에요. 찾으러 오실 때 이 접수증을 꼭 가져오세요.
dialogue.meaning: Here is your repair receipt. Please be sure to bring it when you come to pick up your phone.

exercises: Change the verb with -(으)ㄹ 때 and complete the sentence: ① (사진을 찍다) ____ 앱이 자꾸 멈춰요. ② (게임을 하다) ____ 휴대폰이 너무 뜨거워요. ③ (문자를 보내다) ____ 키보드가 안 나와요.
Choose the right word: 휴대폰을 바닥에 (떨어뜨려서 / 충전해서) 화면이 깨졌어요.
Read and answer in English. What do you need to bring when you pick up your phone? (신분증 = ID card): 수리가 끝나면 문자 드릴게요. 찾으러 오실 때 신분증을 가져오세요.
Say it in Korean (영상 통화 = video call): Tell the staff, "When I make a video call, the screen turns off."
answers: ① 사진을 찍을 때 ② 게임을 할 때 ③ 문자를 보낼 때
Your ID card (신분증). They will send you a text when the repair is done.
영상 통화를 할 때 화면이 꺼져요. (영상 통화할 때 화면이 꺼져요.)
